text.text:
I don't understand all the hype around kyousuke... Falcons can't win anything since he joined. Magisk wasn't my favorite either but at least with him in the team Falcons fought vs Vitality in almost every final. kyo's death rate is through the roof, he dies more often than anyone else, even when his KDA is positive. On top of it all they now want to kick one of the best performing IGLs. karrigan knows how to play with players as explosive as m0NESY, kyo or NiKo but I still don't see him making the difference. A positive one. If anything it will hurt them (Falcons) more than it will help them.
Any team that picks up kyxsan will be happy with this addition.
